about_the_game:
With the M4A1 Revalorisé pack, you'll get:
  • M4A1 Revalorisé (Tier VIII Premium French medium tank) with a Garage slot and crew
  • 2D style: "Sakura Storm"
  • 10 Strong Coffee
  • 10 missions for ×5 XP (M4A1 Revalorisé only)
The M4A1 Revalorisé is the French twist on the M4 Sherman, which the country received from the U.S. through the MDAP program after WWII. The goal was to improve the firepower, and it worked! The M4A1 Revalorisé deals impressive damage for a Tier VIII medium, at times much greater than its predecessor. If you were looking to upgrade your M4 Sherman, don't bother! There's no need when the French have already done it for you. With the "Sakura Storm" 2D style, included in this pack, you can keep it pretty in pink (with an edge)!

DLC can be added to your World of Tanks account only once.
Items will be credited to the first account you log in to the game with.
